description: This file implements a plugin class 'BootimgBiosXenPlugin' for the 'wic' build system, specifically for generating boot images with Xen support. It handles configuration, installation, and preparation of boot partitions involving Xen, syslinux, and related components.

classes.name: BootimgBiosXenPlugin
classes.description: A plugin class for creating Xen-enabled boot images within the 'wic' build system.

methods.name: __init__(cls)
methods.description: Constructor for the plugin class, attempts to instantiate the BIOS class.

methods.name: __instanciateBIOSClass(cls)
methods.description: Dynamically loads and instantiates the 'bootimg-pcbios' plugin class.

methods.name: do_install_disk(cls, disk, disk_name, creator, workdir, oe_builddir, bootimg_dir, kernel_dir, native_sysroot)
methods.description: Handles disk installation after partition assembly, delegates to internal BIOS object.

methods.name: do_configure_partition(cls, part, source_params, creator, cr_workdir, oe_builddir, bootimg_dir, kernel_dir, native_sysroot)
methods.description: Configures the boot partition, especially the syslinux configuration with Xen and Linux args.

methods.name: do_prepare_partition(cls, part, source_params, creator, cr_workdir, oe_builddir, bootimg_dir, kernel_dir, rootfs_dir, native_sysroot)
methods.description: Prepares the partition content, including copying Xen and kernel files, for the boot image.

ctags.signature: (cls, part, source_params, creator, cr_workdir, oe_builddir, bootimg_dir, kernel_dir, rootfs_dir, native_sysroot)
